question: How many teams participated in the ICC Women’s ODI World Cup 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8 teams.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **A total of eight teams participated in the ICC Women’s ODI World Cup 2025 hosted in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The eight participating teams were **India, Australia, England, South Africa, New Zealand, Pakistan, Bangladesh,** and **Sri Lanka.**
 
• **India** hosted and won the tournament, defeating South Africa in the final.
 
• This marked India’s **first-ever Women’s ODI World Cup title.**
 
• The event featured top cricketers from across major cricketing nations.
 
• Final held at **DY Patil Sports Academy, Navi Mumbai.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Winner:** India Women
 
• **Runner-up:** South Africa Women
 
• **Player of the Series:** Deepti Sharma
 
• **Player of the Match (Final):** Shafali Verma
 
• **Total Prize Money:** ₹91 crore (ICC + BCCI bonus)
